# Embedded fonts and rasteriser

The HD dialogue text overlay embeds Latin subsets of eight fonts as C arrays: the three PT families in `src/text_fonts_data.cpp` and the
five extra families of the HD overlay in `src/text_overlay/overlay_fonts_data.cpp` (both generated by
`gen_font_data.py` of gba-improvements, see below). No font file is needed at run time. Users can add their own `.ttf`
files in a `fonts/` folder next to the working directory (see [../../docs/TEXT_OVERLAY_RENDER.md](../../docs/TEXT_OVERLAY_RENDER.md), "User fonts"); those are never shipped.

| Font | Source (downloaded 2026-10-10) | Original SHA-256 | Subset file | Subset SHA-256 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| PT Sans Regular | https://raw.githubusercontent.com/google/fonts/main/ofl/ptsans/PT_Sans-Web-Regular.ttf | `9cc831490532009bae2b3ce0d39c62adfc889060beb421593bfd9d2396d0f10a` | `PTSans-Regular.subset.ttf` | `0ee3ae94685c21888f155a3f022bc97fb6a537bfdbba893dc7fd731957869e5d` |
| PT Sans Narrow Regular | https://raw.githubusercontent.com/google/fonts/main/ofl/ptsansnarrow/PT_Sans-Narrow-Web-Regular.ttf | `4102edda03059163771869d258df54ac8563c408fa6e9ef75b2ddc85eabea6f4` | `PTSansNarrow-Regular.subset.ttf` | `1c863426eae11bddd958921054823d99f4fc1657f595a5d49fc7185a3efa565e` |
| PT Serif Regular | https://raw.githubusercontent.com/google/fonts/main/ofl/ptserif/PT_Serif-Web-Regular.ttf | `a4951fade06ff8f09b7673aa81ffb65a8cd409e24d3289a6dc670bc4dda2557a` | `PTSerif-Regular.subset.ttf` | `a6ec40dc1a59ae89e1fa8dda433a7bdc2b167b7a28d7f77599ca37eecbf75c71` |

* License: SIL Open Font License 1.1, Copyright (c) 2010 ParaType Ltd. (http://www.paratype.com/public), Reserved Font
  Names "PT Sans" and "ParaType" - full text in `OFL-ParaType.txt` (SHA-256
  `2758cf7a872827f39661cf8cc24188113c030447aefb5ca7145993650076ca8c`, from
  https://raw.githubusercontent.com/google/fonts/main/ofl/ptsans/OFL.txt).
* Because the files are subset (a modification) the reserved names are not used for the embedded fonts: the game's
  UI calls them "Humanist Sans / Narrow / Serif".
* Subsetting: `python3 -m fontTools.subset F.ttf --unicodes='U+0020-007E,U+00A0-00FF,U+2018,U+2019,U+201C,U+201D,U+2026,U+2013,U+2014'
  --no-hinting --desubroutinize --layout-features='' --name-IDs='0,1,2,3,13,14' --output-file=F.subset.ttf`
  (fontTools 4.x from Ubuntu 24.04). The licence/copyright name records (IDs 0, 13, 14) are kept in the subset.
* The downloaded files were treated as data only (hashed, subset with fontTools, never executed).
* Regenerate the PT data: `python external/gba-improvements/tools/gen_font_data.py --namespace khcom::textfonts --include text_fonts.h --banner "GENERATED by tools/gen_font_data.py - do not edit. Fonts: see third_party/fonts/README.md (SIL OFL 1.1)." third_party/fonts/PTSans-Regular.subset.ttf third_party/fonts/PTSansNarrow-Regular.subset.ttf
  third_party/fonts/PTSerif-Regular.subset.ttf > src/text_fonts_data.cpp` (order = `Face` in `src/text_fonts.h`: Sans, Narrow, Serif). The output equals the committed file except for one added `#include <cstddef>` line.

## Extra families of the HD dialogue overlay (downloaded 2026-10-11, google/fonts `main`)

All five are SIL OFL 1.1 and were downloaded into a scratch directory, hashed, subset with fontTools and never executed.
UI names are generic (none of the reserved font names is used).

| Pixel Arcade | Press Start 2P Regular (c) 2012 The Press Start 2P Project Authors (RFN "Press Start 2P") - .../ofl/pressstart2p/PressStart2P-Regular.ttf | `034c77f1f05ec89421e4a63f0e3a4ca1ecf852cc6d2bf611f126f275728e017d` | `PressStart2P-Regular.subset.ttf` | `e55eb04b08d8db99dcf483513b4fa94b2d9216017de3f2250278d20fc0709622` |

Licence texts (each from the `OFL.txt` next to the font in google/fonts): `OFL-Atkinson.txt`
(`f32d22b3908fcad2c86a74000614ec22e6a7f66ea7e867e616026a27aebdc143`), `OFL-VarelaRound.txt`
(`45446732635812510428bf1bad902a8b133f3c7348ad8593ecca90895595b278`), `OFL-Cousine.txt`
(`b81c4d4dc0a9f72c9155e78187316e016e2012a8102468804173dc61468b906d`), `OFL-VT323.txt`
(`27d9af34210253e7ca1251fbace86c6f65b40031d6ce1a75493a1b2093631298`), `OFL-PressStart2P.txt`
(`705960c3281a5765ecc0b59bd4ed7ca59eed165748076bc2fc3e8fdbfeb944b0`).

* Subsetting: same as above but `--layout-features='kern'` (fontTools 4.62): `python -m fontTools.subset F.ttf
  --unicodes=... --no-hinting --desubroutinize --layout-features='kern' --name-IDs='0,1,2,3,13,14' --output-file=F.subset.ttf`.
  Subset sizes: 20008 / 29372 / 15112 / 44336 / 15444 bytes (about 124 KB, about 650 KB of C source).
* Regenerate the data: `python external/gba-improvements/tools/gen_font_data.py --namespace khcom::overlay --include overlay_fonts_data.h --data-fn extra_face_data --size-fn extra_face_size --count-fn extra_face_count --banner "GENERATED by tools/gen_font_data.py --extra - do not edit. Fonts: see third_party/fonts/README.md (SIL OFL 1.1)." third_party/fonts/AtkinsonHyperlegible-Regular.subset.ttf
  third_party/fonts/VarelaRound-Regular.subset.ttf third_party/fonts/Cousine-Regular.subset.ttf
  third_party/fonts/VT323-Regular.subset.ttf third_party/fonts/PressStart2P-Regular.subset.ttf > src/text_overlay/overlay_fonts_data.cpp`
  (order = the entries with `source` 100, 101, ... of `kBuiltins` in `src/text_overlay/text_adapter.cpp`; the PT faces are `source` 0..2 in `src/text_fonts.h`).
* stb_truetype only reads a legacy `kern` table; the subsets keep no usable pair kerning for stb, so advances are unkerned.

## stb_truetype

`external/gba-improvements/third_party/stb/stb_truetype.h`, v1.26, public domain (Sean Barrett / RAD Game Tools; vendored by gba-improvements), from
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nothings/stb/master/stb_truetype.h, SHA-256
`ecd30b05e0dd4fea3a13c26810dd9e1992dc379049482c393d5a19e6b5090aab`. Used by the text engine of gba-improvements (`text_fonts.cpp`: glyph
rasterisation; no hinting bytecode).
